description:
Check whether a person qualifies for citizenship by descent.

    Input is the person's direct ancestral line, one entry per generation,
    starting with relation='self'. Every generation between the person and
    the ancestor is required, because descent passes generation by generation
    and a gap changes the answer.

    Exact dates give the most precise result. Year-only input is accepted and
    the result carries a caveat; for Ireland, a registration and a birth in the
    same year cannot be resolved.

    Args:
        country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, lowercase. Currently 'ie' or 'ca'.
        line: The direct line, from the user upward.
        as_of: Evaluation date. Defaults to today. Rules with commencement
            dates (Canada's Bill C-3) depend on it.

LineMember.description: One person on the user's direct ancestral line.

birth_date.title: Birth Date

citizenship_registered_date.title: Citizenship Registered Date

citizenship_registered_year.title: Citizenship Registered Year

days_in_country.title: Days In Country

naturalized_country.title: Naturalized Country

naturalized_year.description: Year this person naturalized in naturalized_country, if they did.
naturalized_year.title: Naturalized Year

relation.description: Where this person sits on the direct line. Exactly one entry is 'self'.
